title: 第395章 六道轮转劫与突破天仙第394章 神农传道与冲击天仙
lines: 六道轮盘降下来的时候整个轩辕城都看见了。
天穹之上六道巨大的金色轮盘一字排开，从东到西覆压百里。
每一道轮盘都代表神族的天刑体系中的一种惩罚法则：天道镇压——无穷重力的金色巨印从九天深处直往下压，法则本身不攻击人体而是以无法承受的负荷将修士连人带道同时压平。
人道迷心——万千人间杂念在一瞬间被放大亿万倍涌入识海，让渡劫者被自己此生所有未曾消散的执念碎片同时围攻陷入混乱。
修罗道嗜血——将所有杀伐因果在识海中重新播放并附加神族血咒的暴怒挑唆，引诱修士在理智崩溃的瞬间攻击虚无的幻影自残经脉。
畜生道退化——一种强行反转人体经脉进化方向的上古禁咒令灵力在经脉中以野兽的原始状态乱窜试图将修士的道基打回原始散乱态。
饿鬼道吞噬——法则将天地间的吞噬之力全部集中到天劫光圈中形成一个无底大口把修士的道种雏形尚未稳固的神通根基硬生生往外拖出丹田吸走。
地狱道毁灭——最直接最纯粹的神族灭绝力量：将上述五道刑罚的残余威能全数回收集中到一端化为一道贯穿一切的金黑色毁灭光柱直接轰击修士的肉身和元神。
无名老道在青铜塔上睁开了一只左眼——上次他睁的是右眼。左眼看天，右眼看地。
此刻两只眼同时睁开了。姬老从议会桌前站起身走到窗边望向城西那片荒丘上方越来越浓的金色轮盘云层。他手里端着的茶已经凉了——没人给他换。
城墙上巡逻的人族修士们全部停下了脚步。他们见过上仙境江寒渡劫时金黑交错的劫云异象，那天他们已经觉得极为震撼。
但跟今天比，那天只是天障的在外围禁制。今天是核心。
六道轮盘同降——方圆数十里的天空被六种不同的刑罚之光同时斜射，荒丘上刮起的风是热的、灼心的、又忽而变成冰针刺骨的随机轮替。
石青璇在院中以万物有灵诀维持的那张生机网在劫云压下时被激得整体鼓胀了一下。
她稳住箫声，将频率调到与江寒丹田中万物生同步的低频基础音域——不是干预渡劫，是以最轻微的生机关怀将他在劫中受到的伤害减到最低。
第一道轮盘——天道镇压——压下时江寒以佛门道种雏形正面迎击。
如来净土开到极致，金莲在头顶张开一重又一重以万钧佛光顶住了那无法承受的重压。金色巨印压在佛光上时荒丘地表被压得整体下凹了寸许。
江寒脚下那座风化石表面直接裂成了几瓣。他的脊椎被重压压得弯了下——偏折幅度极小但足以说明重压的恐怖程度。
佛门道种在重压中反而被压得更紧实了，道种外缘在巨大压强下自行完成了第一层凝固壳的烧制——天道镇压成了一次被动锻打。
第二道轮盘——人道迷心——紧随其后。
万千杂念涌入识海时江寒道门道种以太极化生将这些杂乱的信息流全部纳入太极圈中不断拆分重组——记忆碎片的每一次冲撞都在太极圈中被阴阳二气分化反向构成了道门道种内部的信息结构。
他用一生的记忆作原材料让道门道种在化解迷心的同时消化了自身所经历的全部因果。
道心清明。不被任何记忆所伤。
第三道轮盘——修罗道嗜血——被他以魔门道种的魔渊吞噬直接吃掉。
暴怒的血咒冲入黑莲后碾碎化为纯粹的魔性原材料，反而补强了魔门道种的杀意核心。
第四道轮盘——畜生道退化——被他用星门道种的星辉普照以最纯净的九天星辰法则直接压倒。
星辰之力不触及经脉本身，它以更高维度的能量将退化法则从源头上冲散为散碎的无害光粒。
第五道与第六道轮盘——饿鬼道吞噬与地狱道毁灭——同时压下。
江寒在这一刻将四枚道种以万物生的总纲为唯一纽带同时点亮——四道归一。
不是四条独立的防御线，是一张网。金莲托住佛光层、太极分解吞噬法则、黑莲吞掉毁灭法则边缘的魔性碎片、星河将残留的神力冲击转化为星能反哺其余三者。
四道共鸣。
六道轮盘同降的碾压态势被这张四象网整体托住了。劫云在九息之后开始由中心向外逐层溃缩，每一层轮盘的法则碎片溃散时都化为大量无主的高纯灵力从云层中倾泻而下被万物生鲸吞入丹田，反哺进四枚刚凝成雏形的道种。
天劫散尽。
荒丘上方云层被洗得一尘不染，六道轮盘的最后一缕金色残影在西边天际拉成一道极细的淡金色横线然后消失。
丹田中四枚道种凝形完毕。
content_en:
When the Six Paths Roulette came down, the entire Xuanyuan City saw it.
Six huge golden roulette wheels were lined up in the sky, covering hundreds of miles from east to west.
Each roulette represents a punishment law in the God Clan's Heavenly Punishment System: Heavenly Suppression - The golden seal of infinite gravity presses down from the depths of the Nine Heavens. The law itself does not attack the human body, but flattens the monks together with the unbearable load at the same time.
The obsession of humanity - Thousands of distracting thoughts in the human world are amplified billions of times in an instant and pour into the sea of ​​consciousness, causing the person who has overcome the tribulation to be simultaneously besieged by all the fragments of obsessions that have not dissipated in this life and fall into chaos.
The Bloodthirst of the Shura Path - replays the cause and effect of all killings in the sea of ​​consciousness and adds the violent instigation of the divine blood curse, tempting the monks to attack the void phantom self-inflicted meridians at the moment when their sanity collapses.
Degeneration of the animal path - an ancient forbidden spell that forcibly reverses the evolutionary direction of the human body's meridians, causing spiritual power to run wildly in the meridians in the primitive state of beasts, trying to bring the monk's path back to its original scattered state.
The Hungry Ghost Dao Devouring - The law concentrates all the devouring power between heaven and earth into the aperture of the heavenly tribulation, forming a bottomless mouth that forcefully drags the monk's Tao seed prototype and the foundation of his supernatural power out of the Dantian and sucks it away.
Hell Realm Destruction - the most direct and pure force of annihilation of the gods: all the residual power of the above five punishments is recovered and concentrated at one end, turning it into a golden and black beam of destruction light that penetrates everything and directly bombards the monk's body and soul.
The unknown old Taoist opened a left eye on the bronze tower - last time he opened his right eye. The left eye looks at the sky and the right eye looks at the earth.
At this moment, both eyes opened at the same time. Mr. Ji stood up from the parliament table and walked to the window to look at the increasingly dense golden roulette clouds above the barren hills in the west of the city. The tea he was holding was cold - no one changed it for him.
All the human monks patrolling the city wall stopped. They had seen the golden and black tribulation clouds when Jiang Han was crossing the tribulation in the Upper Immortal Realm. They had already felt extremely shocked that day.
But compared with today, that day it was just a natural barrier on the outside. Today is the core.
The six roulette wheels descended at the same time - the sky with a radius of dozens of miles was slanted by six different kinds of punishment lights at the same time, and the wind blowing on the barren hills was hot, heart-searing, and suddenly turned into icy needles in random turns.
The vitality net maintained by Shi Qingxuan in the courtyard with the Animist Technique was swollen when the calamity cloud pressed down on it.
She stabilized the sound of the flute and adjusted the frequency to a low-frequency basic sound range that was synchronized with all things in Jiang Han's dantian—not to intervene in the tribulation, but to minimize the damage he suffered during the tribulation with the slightest vital concern.
When the first roulette wheel - Heavenly Dao Suppression - was suppressed, Jiang Han faced it head-on with the prototype of Buddhist Dao.
The Tathagata's pure land has been opened to the extreme, and the golden lotus is spread out over the top of the head, one after another, using thousands of rays of Buddha's light to withstand the unbearable pressure. When the giant golden seal pressed against the Buddha's light, the surface of the barren hill was dented by an inch.
The surface of the weathered stone at Jiang Han's feet cracked into several petals. His spine was bent under the heavy pressure - the deflection was very small but it was enough to illustrate the terrifying degree of the pressure.
The Buddhist Tao Seed was pressed even tighter under the heavy pressure, and the outer edge of the Tao Seed completed the firing of the first layer of solidified shell on its own under the huge pressure - the suppression of the Heavenly Dao became a passive forging.
The second roulette wheel - the Humane Heart - follows closely behind.
When thousands of distracting thoughts poured into the sea of ​​consciousness, Jiang Han Dao Sect's Taoism was transformed into Tai Chi, and all these messy information flows were incorporated into the Tai Chi circle and continuously split and reorganized - every collision of memory fragments was differentiated by Yin and Yang in the Tai Chi circle and reversely formed the internal information structure of Tao Sect Taoism.
He used a lifetime of memories as raw materials to allow Taoism and Taoism to digest all the causes and effects he had experienced while resolving confusion.
The Tao mind is clear. Not hurt by any memory.
The third roulette wheel - Bloodthirsty of Shura Dao - was directly eaten by him using the demonic abyss of the Demon Sect.
The furious blood curse rushed into the black lotus and crushed it into pure demonic raw materials, which instead strengthened the murderous core of the demon sect.
The fourth roulette wheel - the degradation of the animal path - was directly overwhelmed by him using the starlight of the Star Gate Tao Seed and the purest Nine Heavens Star Law.
The power of the stars does not touch the meridians themselves. It uses higher-dimensional energy to disperse the degenerate laws from their source into scattered harmless light particles.
The wheels of the fifth and sixth paths—the devouring of the hungry ghost realm and the destruction of the hell realm—are pressed down at the same time.
At this moment, Jiang Han lit up the four Tao seeds at the same time with the general outline of all things as the only link - the four Tao were unified.
Not four separate lines of defense, but a net. The Golden Lotus holds the Buddha's Light Layer, Tai Chi decomposes and swallows the Law of Destruction, the Black Lotus swallows the demonic fragments on the edge of the Law of Destruction, and the Galaxy converts the remaining divine power impact into star energy to feed back the other three.
Four resonances.
The crushing situation of the six roulette wheels falling together is supported by this four-image net as a whole. After nine breaths, the calamity cloud began to collapse layer by layer from the center outward. When the law fragments of each layer of the roulette collapsed, they turned into a large amount of ownerless high-purity spiritual power pouring down from the clouds and being swallowed by the whales of all things into the Dantian, feeding back into the four Tao seeds that had just condensed into embryonic form.
The catastrophe is over.
The clouds above the barren hills were washed away spotlessly, and the last golden shadow of the six-way wheel stretched into a very thin pale golden horizontal line in the western sky and then disappeared.
The four Tao seeds in the dantian are completed.
